final: WITH c AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS n FROM film f LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), a1 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS m FROM c), k1 AS (SELECT c.film_id, c.n, c.n - a1.m AS e1 FROM c, a1 WHERE c.n > a1.m), a2 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.n, k1.e1, k1.n - a2.m AS e2 FROM k1, a2 WHERE k1.n > a2.m) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_actors, AVG(e1) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(e2) AS avg_excess_second FROM k2
